WHAT TO REVIEW

Six changes, one ocean.

This preview uses sample positions. Your game and saves are unchanged.

  1. 1
    A bigger battleship

    Split bow waves, visible white foam and spray across the front deck.

  2. 2
    Bow follows the route

    Turns at the corners; faces left on the bottom edge without flipping upside down.

  3. 3
    Water over the properties

    Water washes back and forth. Buildings remain visible below the surface.

  4. 4
    Floating card decks

    Community and Chance bob above the flooded center.

  5. 5
    A board in the ocean

    Rolling water, edge foam and a soft shadow beneath the floating board.

  6. 6
    Landings have weight

    Each square dips, wiggles and sends out ripples as a piece lands.

Same Tsunami rules. Water is a visual treatment. Submerged spaces stay safe, collect no rent and have no property value. Flood shields still protect once.
